text_block_list.text: Thanks! Ehe, it really does feel good. ♪

text_block_list.text: But it's not over yet. Tomorrow...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
The results of the first Cutie ♪ Derby
will come in!

text_block_list.text:
The next day, around noon, I finish
counting the
likes and meet up with
Каррен Тян and Biko
Pegasus. Of
course, they're streaming the results

announcement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gulp!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян and Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Oof! I lost!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
They had almost the same number of
likes. Curren
Chan made more posts,
which ended up just
barely pushing her
ahead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the same, I lost both the race and
the Cutie ♪
Derby... There's no getting
around it.
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text: Tell me, Curren. How did I lose?!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Hm... If I had to say, I'd say it's probably
because
of the audiences we were
aiming for.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Take me, for example. I'm always cute.
And
everyone likes cute, right?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
As long as I put myself out there, I can
reach
anyone. I think that's why I get so
many likes from
people of all ages and
genders.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
But instead of reaching out to everyone
you
could, you chose to stick with what
you
personally think is fun.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Ah...
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Now I can play around and recreate
scenes from
Carrot Ranger! All my fellow
hero fans really
loved it too!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
I see... I wasn't appealing enough to
people
outside of my core audience.
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
That's not necessarily a bad thing. It
might not
have worked out for this
competition, but that's
just because of
the specific guidelines we set to

determine a winner.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Besides, what's important is that the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen was more fun
because
we raced together. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

at this
video!"

course."
text_block_list.name: Commentator A

text_block_list.text: "Cute Каррен Тян!"

"Huh?! Um, well, in any case, it looks
like we'll
have to keep our eyes on the
future sprints!"
text_block_list.name: TV Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
The race was so exciting that it even
made the
news. Don't you think that's
amazing?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: And for that, I have to say thanks, Biko.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I-I see!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Thank you too, Каррен Тян. I've really
grown
thanks to our battle.
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
The next time we meet, I'll be an
entirely new me.
And when that time
comes... I'll definitely defeat
you!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're on! I'll be happy to squash
your big
comeback before it begins. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
...Wow, Curren. You might fit the bad
guy role
even more than I thought...
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Bad guy? Awww, at least make me the
Dark Lady
of Cuteness or something.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
And so, Каррен Тян wins the first battle
of the
Cutie ♪ Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the war is hardly over. We go
straight to a
diner for a strategy
meeting.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So, about my next race...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: So, about my next race...

text_block_list.text: I wanna run in the Sprinters Stakes again!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

It's unusual for Каррен Тян to suggest a
race
herself.

There aren't that many G1 sprints so I
was going

Sprinters Stakes again
myself, but...

I think I mentioned before that I spoke
with all
the Cutie ♪ Derby participants
before I
announced it, right? Well...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
At that time, they all said they were
planning to
run in the Sprinters Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Don't you think that makes for a super
simple,
perfect next step?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Well, I'm on a high after beating Biko.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I wanna take this momentum and use it
to go up
against everyone all at once! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Тайки Шаттл, Хиши Акэбоно, and
Sakura
Bakushin O. They're all the
absolute cream of the
crop.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. It's not like we
need
different tactics for each of them,
right?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. It's not like we
need
different tactics for each of them,
right?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It's a sprint, after all. I can win if I just
run faster
than everyone else... Right?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She's not wrong, but the race isn't the
only thing
we need to consider
strategy-wise.

My victory against Biko went according
to plan,

everyone

hearts as
the most beloved runner ever!
